cash_breakdown.reason: Can be used after maturity or financing rearrangement, subject to timing and extraction friction.

cash_breakdown.reason: Shorter maturity than non-current deposits, still subject to group-level extraction uncertainty.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC bank principal-guaranteed structured deposits maturing within one year, but measured at FVTPL because cash flows are not solely principal and interest.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash-like treasury products, not treated as full cash because payoff and Mainland extraction path add friction.

cash_breakdown.reason: Financing liabilities must be repaid or assumed by a controlling buyer.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Estimated reserve equals about 5% of 2024 revenue for a manufacturer with one-to-three-month customer credit, large receivables and payables, and volatile cash flow.
cash_breakdown.reason: Must remain in the business to support raw materials, payroll, production and working-capital swings.
cash_breakdown.source: Owner-earnback estimate based on 2024 annual report revenue, receivable/payable terms and cash-flow volatility

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Ordinary operating leases are not mechanically deducted from detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Continuing leases are reflected in operating cash generation and profit haircut unless a closure/liquidation case is used.
cash_breakdown.source: 2024 annual report statement of financial position and note 31(b), pp.51-52, 135

profit_quality.assessment: Low. Three-year reported parent profit series is HK$137.287 million, -HK$1,229.656 million and -HK$3,942.177 million. 2024 contains large non-cash impairments, but gross margin was negative and operating cash flow relied heavily on working-capital release. The pre-haircut denominator is therefore the three-year median operating free cash flow of HK$84.232 million, not reported net profit.
adjustments: Excluded 2024 fixed-asset impairment of HK$1,977.624 million from judging recurring cash loss, but treated it as evidence of impaired earning power.
Treated 2024 inventory provision of HK$508.894 million as evidence of price/stock risk rather than add-back to a high-quality profit number.
Excluded one-off disposal gain of HK$133.050 million from recurring profit.
Used purchases of property, plant and equipment as conservative capex because maintenance capex was not separately disclosed.
Applied 0.30 profit haircut because reported profits are negative in two of three years and 2024 free cash flow was supported by working-capital release.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating free cash flow was HK$84.232 million in 2022, -HK$278.591 million in 2023 and HK$184.428 million in 2024; median HK$84.232 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Heavy haircut for unstable profitability, negative 2023-2024 reported earnings, weak gross margin, inventory risk and working-capital dependence.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2024 OCF was positive, but the cash bridge includes large payables increase and other receivable release; this is not treated as fully repeatable.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not disclosed; 2024 purchases of PPE of HK$400.063 million and MD&A capex of about HK$454.0 million show that the business still absorbs meaningful capital.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables remain large at HK$2.119 billion and inventory was written down heavily; working capital can release cash in one year but also absorbs cash across cycles.

limitations: Market-cap input required a 50-for-1 share-consolidation adjustment; if downstream insists on the unadjusted rough-screen market cap, the earnback years would be meaningless and far higher.
Cash is disclosed at group level and cannot be cleanly split by parent, offshore and Mainland subsidiaries.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; purchases of PPE are used as a conservative proxy.
2024 operating cash flow benefited from working-capital release and cannot be treated as a stable profit run-rate.
